files.justification: GATE 4 default: line_count=340 < 350. Single responsibility: device export/credential/cert helpers for cfgutil-based iOS device access.

GATE 4 default: single shared responsibility is building the mobileconfig home-screen profile payload from a normalized layout export; all classes/helpers (Page, HomeScreenConfigBuilder, HslPayloadConfig, folder/dock/pages builders) feed into build_mobileconfig in one tightly coupled data flow, no independent cluster.
GATE 4 default: line_count=201 < 350. Single responsibility: normalize raw iconstate export into NormalizedLayout and derive location/page maps.

GATE 4 default: single shared responsibility is iPhone reorg orchestration and device I/O; cmd_reorg calls _resolve_reorg_udid/_reorg_export/_reorg_merge/_reorg_build_profile/_reorg_install/_reorg_summary in a deep call chain, no independent cluster.

GATE 4 default: proposed classify_to_folder() cluster is called BY the merge-orchestration cluster (_file_apps_into_folders etc.), which fails the GATE 3 independence requirement (clusters must not call each other). Single shared responsibility: classify apps and merge them into the existing layout's folders/pages.

GATE 3 naming test: verified by reading the file — cluster A 'layout pipelines' (ExportRequest/Result/Processor/Producer, PlanRequest/Result/Processor/Producer, ChecklistRequest/Result/Processor/Producer, UnusedRequest/Result/Processor/Producer, PruneRequest/Result/Processor/Producer, AnalyzeRequest/Result/Processor/Producer) all operate on a load_layout()-produced dict; cluster B 'device I/O pipelines' (ExportDeviceRequest/Result/Processor/Producer, IconmapRequest/Result/Processor/Producer) both shell out to cfgutil via .device imports. Neither cluster calls the other; both only share the BaseProducer base class, not mutable state. Unused top-level helpers (_collect_unique_app, _process_page_folders, _process_pages, _build_manifest_from_export) are dead code in this file, not part of either cluster.
